name: Remote call-centre, chat & email customer support (category)
summary: Work-from-home customer service jobs answering customers by phone, chat or email for retailers, outsourcers and other companies across Canada.
whatYouDo: You answer customer questions, fix order, account or product problems, document each contact and escalate tricky cases, working scheduled shifts against quality and speed targets. Many roles mix phone with chat and email; some retail roles also involve upselling.
appeal: Job Bank says the occupation usually needs secondary school or several weeks of on-the-job training
Remote postings for people living in Canada exist now (e.g. a retailer posted one on 2026-10-05)
Employers often supply laptop, headset and monitor
Mostly employee roles with paid training
watchOuts: Regional median wages on Job Bank are roughly $18–$25/hr; remote postings seen paid $17–$18/hr
Shift work incl. weekends/holidays, metrics and call-handling targets
Many remote postings are temporary or limited to some provinces
Job scams imitate real employers: 2,300+ Canadians reported losing $49M+ to job scams in 2024
Never deposit an 'employer' cheque, buy equipment, or reply to unsolicited job texts

training.notes: Postings seen describe employer-run (often paid) training.

compensation.notes: Spread of Job Bank regional MEDIAN wages seen for call-centre CSRs (NOC 64409): MB North Central ~18.27, NS ~18.53, ON ~21.50, North Coast region ~25.30. Medians, not a floor/ceiling.

reliability.notes: Employee roles usually give steady shifts; many remote postings are temporary/seasonal.

applicationSteps: Search Job Bank, employer career sites and reputable job boards for 'remote customer service Canada'
Check province eligibility, schedule, pay and whether it is employee or contractor
Verify the employer domain before sharing ID or banking info
Report suspected job scams to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre (1-888-495-8501)
fitsIf: You are patient with people, can keep to a shift schedule and want an accessible entry into remote work.
notFitIf: You strongly dislike live calls, metrics or rigid schedules.
